package answer

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

type requiredVariable struct {
	Name string
	Type string
}

type requiredProperty struct {
	Name string
	Type string
}

type requiredInterface struct {
	Name               string
	RequiredProperties []requiredProperty
	OptionalProperties []requiredProperty
}

type requiredFunction struct {
	Name string
}

type requiredConstruct struct {
	Type       string
	TextEquals string
	MinItems   int
}

type requiredClassMethod struct {
	Name          string
	ReturnsString bool
}

type requiredClass struct {
	Name       string
	Properties []string
	Methods    []requiredClassMethod
}

type requiredReactStateVariable struct {
	NameOptions  []string
	InitialValue string
}

type requiredReactHandler struct {
	TargetTag    string
	Event        string
	ChangesState string
}

type requiredReactRender struct {
	Component string
	Props     map[string][]string
}

type reactTreeRequirement struct {
	Tag                  string
	TextEqualsAny        []string
	TextContainsAny      []string
	TextTemplateContains []string
	Children             []reactTreeRequirement
}

type requiredReactComponent struct {
	Name           string
	Kind           string
	PropsRequired  []string
	HookNames      []string
	HooksFromReact []string
	StateVariables []requiredReactStateVariable
	ReturnTree     *reactTreeRequirement
	Handlers       []requiredReactHandler
	MustRender     []requiredReactRender
}

type requiredRoute struct {
	Method string
	Path   string
}

func extractRequiredFiles(raw any) []string {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(arr))
	out := make([]string, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		var path string
		switch typed := item.(type) {
		case string:
			path = normalizePath(typed)
		case map[string]any:
			if rawPath, ok := typed["path"].(string); ok {
				path = normalizePath(rawPath)
			}
		}
		if path == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, exists := seen[path]; exists {
			continue
		}
		seen[path] = struct{}{}
		out = append(out, path)
	}
	return out
}

func mergeUniqueStrings(chunks ...[]string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	out := make([]string, 0)
	for _, chunk := range chunks {
		for _, item := range chunk {
			if item == "" {
				continue
			}
			if _, exists := seen[item]; exists {
				continue
			}
			seen[item] = struct{}{}
			out = append(out, item)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredStrings(raw any) []string {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		value, ok := item.(string)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if trimmed == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, trimmed)
	}
	return out
}

func extractStringFields(raw any, field string) []string {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		value, ok := obj[field].(string)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if trimmed == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, trimmed)
	}
	return out
}

func extractNestedStringFields(raw any, parentField, field string) []string {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]string, 0)
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		parent, ok := obj[parentField].([]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, extractRequiredStrings(parent)...)
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredVariables(raw any) []requiredVariable {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredVariable, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		if name, ok := item.(string); ok {
			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
			if name == "" {
				continue
			}
			out = append(out, requiredVariable{Name: name})
			continue
		}
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		name, _ := obj["name"].(string)
		valueType, _ := obj["type"].(string)
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		valueType = strings.TrimSpace(valueType)
		if name == "" || valueType == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, requiredVariable{Name: name, Type: valueType})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredConstructs(raw any) []requiredConstruct {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredConstruct, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		constructType, _ := obj["type"].(string)
		constructType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(constructType))
		if constructType == "" {
			continue
		}
		textEquals, _ := obj["text_equals"].(string)
		out = append(out, requiredConstruct{
			Type:       constructType,
			TextEquals: strings.TrimSpace(textEquals),
			MinItems:   extractInt(obj["min_items"]),
		})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredClasses(raw any) []requiredClass {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredClass, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		name, _ := obj["name"].(string)
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if name == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, requiredClass{
			Name:       name,
			Properties: extractRequiredStrings(obj["properties"]),
			Methods:    extractRequiredClassMethods(obj["methods"]),
		})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredClassMethods(raw any) []requiredClassMethod {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredClassMethod, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		name, _ := obj["name"].(string)
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if name == "" {
			continue
		}
		returnsString, _ := obj["returns_string"].(bool)
		out = append(out, requiredClassMethod{Name: name, ReturnsString: returnsString})
	}
	return out
}

func extractProperties(raw any) []requiredProperty {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredProperty, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		name, _ := obj["name"].(string)
		valueType, _ := obj["type"].(string)
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		valueType = strings.TrimSpace(valueType)
		if name == "" || valueType == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, requiredProperty{Name: name, Type: valueType})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredInterfaces(raw any) []requiredInterface {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredInterface, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		name, _ := obj["name"].(string)
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if name == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, requiredInterface{
			Name:               name,
			RequiredProperties: extractProperties(obj["required_properties"]),
			OptionalProperties: extractProperties(obj["optional_properties"]),
		})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredFunctions(raw any) []requiredFunction {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredFunction, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		name, _ := obj["name"].(string)
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if name == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, requiredFunction{Name: name})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredMethods(raw any) []string {
	methods := extractStringFields(raw, "method")
	return mergeUniqueStrings(methods)
}

func extractRequiredRoutes(raw any) []requiredRoute {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredRoute, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		method, _ := obj["method"].(string)
		path, _ := obj["path"].(string)
		method = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(method))
		path = strings.TrimSpace(path)
		if method == "" || path == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, requiredRoute{Method: method, Path: path})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredReactComponents(payload map[string]any) []requiredReactComponent {
	out := make([]requiredReactComponent, 0)
	if single, ok := payload["expected_component"].(map[string]any); ok {
		if component, ok := extractRequiredReactComponent(single); ok {
			out = append(out, component)
		}
	}
	if arr, ok := payload["expected_components"].([]any); ok {
		for _, item := range arr {
			obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			if component, ok := extractRequiredReactComponent(obj); ok {
				out = append(out, component)
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredReactComponent(raw map[string]any) (requiredReactComponent, bool) {
	name, _ := raw["name"].(string)
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" {
		return requiredReactComponent{}, false
	}
	component := requiredReactComponent{
		Name:           name,
		Kind:           strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asString(raw["kind"]))),
		PropsRequired:  nil,
		HookNames:      nil,
		HooksFromReact: nil,
		StateVariables: nil,
		ReturnTree:     extractReactTreeRequirement(raw["return_tree"]),
		Handlers:       extractRequiredReactHandlers(raw["events"]),
		MustRender:     extractRequiredReactRenders(raw["must_render"]),
	}
	if props, ok := raw["props"].(map[string]any); ok {
		component.PropsRequired = extractRequiredStrings(props["required"])
	}
	if hooks, ok := raw["hooks"].(map[string]any); ok {
		requiredHooks, _ := hooks["required"].([]any)
		for _, item := range requiredHooks {
			obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			hookName := strings.TrimSpace(asString(obj["name"]))
			if hookName == "" {
				continue
			}
			component.HookNames = append(component.HookNames, hookName)
			if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(asString(obj["from"])), "react") {
				component.HooksFromReact = append(component.HooksFromReact, hookName)
			}
		}
	}
	if state, ok := raw["state"].(map[string]any); ok {
		variables, _ := state["variables"].([]any)
		for _, item := range variables {
			obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			names := extractRequiredStrings(obj["name_any"])
			if len(names) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			component.StateVariables = append(component.StateVariables, requiredReactStateVariable{
				NameOptions:  names,
				InitialValue: strings.TrimSpace(asString(obj["initial_value"])),
			})
		}
	}
	return component, true
}

func extractReactTreeRequirement(raw any) *reactTreeRequirement {
	obj, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	tree := &reactTreeRequirement{
		Tag:                  strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asString(obj["tag"]))),
		TextEqualsAny:        extractRequiredStrings(obj["text_equals_any"]),
		TextContainsAny:      extractRequiredStrings(obj["text_contains_any"]),
		TextTemplateContains: extractRequiredStrings(obj["text_template_contains"]),
	}
	if children, ok := obj["children"].([]any); ok {
		for _, child := range children {
			if requirement := extractReactTreeRequirement(child); requirement != nil {
				tree.Children = append(tree.Children, *requirement)
			}
		}
	}
	return tree
}

func extractRequiredReactHandlers(raw any) []requiredReactHandler {
	obj, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	arr, ok := obj["required_handlers"].([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredReactHandler, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		handler, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, requiredReactHandler{
			TargetTag:    strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(asString(handler["target_tag"]))),
			Event:        strings.TrimSpace(asString(handler["event"])),
			ChangesState: strings.TrimSpace(asString(handler["changes_state"])),
		})
	}
	return out
}

func extractRequiredReactRenders(raw any) []requiredReactRender {
	arr, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]requiredReactRender, 0, len(arr))
	for _, item := range arr {
		obj, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		component := strings.TrimSpace(asString(obj["component"]))
		if component == "" {
			continue
		}
		props := make(map[string][]string)
		if propsRaw, ok := obj["props"].(map[string]any); ok {
			for propName, propRule := range propsRaw {
				ruleObj, ok := propRule.(map[string]any)
				if !ok {
					continue
				}
				values := extractRequiredStrings(ruleObj["equals_any"])
				if len(values) == 0 {
					continue
				}
				props[propName] = values
			}
		}
		out = append(out, requiredReactRender{Component: component, Props: props})
	}
	return out
}

func collectRequiredNeedles(rules map[string]any) []string {
	keys := []string{
		"required_strings",
		"required_tags",
		"required_selectors",
		"required_properties",
		"required_values",
		"required_globals",
		"uses_middleware",
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	out := make([]string, 0)
	for _, key := range keys {
		for _, value := range extractRequiredStrings(rules[key]) {
			if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
				continue
			}
			seen[value] = struct{}{}
			out = append(out, value)
		}
	}
	for _, value := range mergeUniqueStrings(
		extractStringFields(rules["required_pages"], "contains"),
		extractStringFields(rules["required_routes"], "path"),
		extractStringFields(rules["required_api_routes"], "method"),
		extractStringFields(rules["required_functions"], "uses_array_method"),
		extractNestedStringFields(rules["required_routes"], "required_body_fields", ""),
	) {
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		out = append(out, value)
	}
	return out
}

func hasRequiredVariable(contents []string, requirement requiredVariable) bool {
	if requirement.Type == "" {
		patterns := []string{
			fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\$\s*%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Name)),
			fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:export\s+)?(?:const|let|var)\s+%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Name)),
		}
		for _, pattern := range patterns {
			if matchesAny(contents, pattern) {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:export\s+)?(?:const|let|var)\s+%s\s*:\s*%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Name), regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Type))
	return matchesAny(contents, pattern)
}

func hasRequiredInterface(contents []string, requirement requiredInterface) bool {
	body := ""
	for _, content := range contents {
		body = extractInterfaceBody(content, requirement.Name)
		if body != "" {
			break
		}
	}
	if body == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, prop := range requirement.RequiredProperties {
		pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b%s\s*:\s*%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(prop.Name), regexp.QuoteMeta(prop.Type))
		if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(body) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, prop := range requirement.OptionalProperties {
		pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b%s\?\s*:\s*%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(prop.Name), regexp.QuoteMeta(prop.Type))
		if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(body) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func hasRequiredFunction(contents []string, requirement requiredFunction) bool {
	patterns := []string{
		fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\bfunction\s+%s\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Name)),
		fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\bfunction\s+%s\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Name)),
		fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:export\s+)?(?:const|let|var)\s+%s\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?function\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Name)),
		fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:export\s+)?(?:const|let|var)\s+%s\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\([^)]*\)|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=>`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.Name)),
	}
	for _, pattern := range patterns {
		if matchesAny(contents, pattern) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hasRequiredMethod(contents []string, method string) bool {
	pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\.\s*%s\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(method))
	return matchesAny(contents, pattern)
}

func hasRequiredRoute(contents []string, route requiredRoute) bool {
	pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)\.\s*%s\s*\(\s*['"]%s['"]`, strings.ToLower(route.Method), regexp.QuoteMeta(route.Path))
	return matchesAny(contents, pattern)
}

func hasRequiredConstruct(contents []string, requirement requiredConstruct) bool {
	for _, content := range contents {
		switch requirement.Type {
		case "echo":
			if requirement.TextEquals != "" {
				pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)\becho\s+['"]%s['"]`, regexp.QuoteMeta(requirement.TextEquals))
				if regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(content) {
					return true
				}
				continue
			}
			if regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)\becho\b`).MatchString(content) {
				return true
			}
		case "foreach":
			if regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)\bforeach\s*\(`).MatchString(content) {
				return true
			}
		case "array_literal":
			if hasPHPArrayLiteral(content, requirement.MinItems) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hasRequiredClass(contents []string, requirement requiredClass) bool {
	for _, content := range contents {
		body := extractPHPClassBody(content, requirement.Name)
		if body == "" {
			continue
		}
		if phpClassBodyMatches(body, requirement) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hasRequiredReactComponent(contents []string, requirement requiredReactComponent) bool {
	source := strings.Join(contents, "\n")
	if !hasReactComponentDefinition(source, requirement.Name, requirement.Kind) {
		return false
	}
	for _, prop := range requirement.PropsRequired {
		if !regexp.MustCompile(fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)\b%s\b|props\.%s|\{[^}]*\b%s\b[^}]*\}`, regexp.QuoteMeta(prop), regexp.QuoteMeta(prop), regexp.QuoteMeta(prop))).MatchString(source) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, hook := range requirement.HookNames {
		if !strings.Contains(source, hook) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, hook := range requirement.HooksFromReact {
		pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)import\s*\{[^}]*\b%s\b[^}]*\}\s*from\s*['"]react['"]|from\s*['"]react['"].*\b%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(hook), regexp.QuoteMeta(hook))
		if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(source) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, stateVar := range requirement.StateVariables {
		if !hasReactStateVariable(source, stateVar) {
			return false
		}
	}
	if requirement.ReturnTree != nil && !reactTreeMatchesSource(source, *requirement.ReturnTree) {
		return false
	}
	for _, handler := range requirement.Handlers {
		if handler.Event != "" && !strings.Contains(source, handler.Event) {
			return false
		}
		if handler.TargetTag != "" {
			pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)<%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(handler.TargetTag))
			if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(source) {
				return false
			}
		}
		if handler.ChangesState != "" {
			setter := "set" + strings.ToUpper(handler.ChangesState[:1]) + handler.ChangesState[1:]
			if !strings.Contains(source, setter) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	for _, render := range requirement.MustRender {
		pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)<%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(render.Component))
		if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(source) {
			return false
		}
		for propName, values := range render.Props {
			matched := false
			for _, value := range values {
				propPattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)%s\s*=\s*['"]%s['"]`, regexp.QuoteMeta(propName), regexp.QuoteMeta(value))
				if regexp.MustCompile(propPattern).MatchString(source) {
					matched = true
					break
				}
			}
			if !matched {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

func extractInterfaceBody(content, name string) string {
	pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?s)\binterface\s+%s\s*\{(.*?)\}`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name))
	match := regexp.MustCompile(pattern).FindStringSubmatch(content)
	if len(match) < 2 {
		return ""
	}
	return match[1]
}

func hasPHPArrayLiteral(content string, minItems int) bool {
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)\[[^\]]*\]|array\s*\([^)]*\)`)
	for _, match := range re.FindAllString(content, -1) {
		if countPHPArrayItems(match) >= minItems {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func countPHPArrayItems(raw string) int {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(trimmed, "]") {
		trimmed = strings.TrimSpace(trimmed[1 : len(trimmed)-1])
	} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "array(") && strings.HasSuffix(trimmed, ")") {
		trimmed = strings.TrimSpace(trimmed[len("array(") : len(trimmed)-1])
	} else {
		return 0
	}
	if trimmed == "" {
		return 0
	}
	count := 0
	for _, item := range strings.Split(trimmed, ",") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(item) != "" {
			count++
		}
	}
	return count
}

func extractPHPClassBody(content, name string) string {
	pattern := regexp.MustCompile(fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)\bclass\s+%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name)))
	match := pattern.FindStringIndex(content)
	if match == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return extractBraceBlock(content, match[1])
}

func extractPHPMethodBody(content, name string) string {
	pattern := regexp.MustCompile(fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)\bfunction\s+%s\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name)))
	match := pattern.FindStringIndex(content)
	if match == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return extractBraceBlock(content, match[1])
}

func extractBraceBlock(content string, from int) string {
	start := strings.Index(content[from:], "{")
	if start == -1 {
		return ""
	}
	start += from
	depth := 0
	for index := start; index < len(content); index++ {
		switch content[index] {
		case '{':
			depth++
		case '}':
			depth--
			if depth == 0 {
				return content[start+1 : index]
			}
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func phpClassBodyMatches(body string, requirement requiredClass) bool {
	for _, property := range requirement.Properties {
		pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\$\s*%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(property))
		if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(body) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, method := range requirement.Methods {
		methodBody := extractPHPMethodBody(body, method.Name)
		if methodBody == "" {
			return false
		}
		if method.ReturnsString && !regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)\breturn\s+['"][^'"]+['"]`).MatchString(methodBody) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func hasReactComponentDefinition(source, name, kind string) bool {
	patterns := []string{
		fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\bfunction\s+%s\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name)),
	}
	if kind == "" || kind == "function_or_arrow" || kind == "function" {
		patterns = append(patterns,
			fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:export\s+default\s+)?function\s+%s\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name)),
			fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:const|let|var)\s+%s\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?function\s*\(`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name)),
		)
	}
	if kind == "" || kind == "function_or_arrow" || kind == "arrow" {
		patterns = append(patterns,
			fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:const|let|var)\s+%s\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?\([^)]*\)\s*=>`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name)),
			fmt.Sprintf(`(?m)\b(?:const|let|var)\s+%s\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=>`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name)),
		)
	}
	return matchesAny([]string{source}, strings.Join(patterns, "|"))
}

func hasReactStateVariable(source string, variable requiredReactStateVariable) bool {
	for _, name := range variable.NameOptions {
		setter := "set" + strings.ToUpper(name[:1]) + name[1:]
		pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)\[\s*%s\s*,\s*%s\s*\]\s*=\s*useState\(\s*%s\s*\)`, regexp.QuoteMeta(name), regexp.QuoteMeta(setter), regexp.QuoteMeta(variable.InitialValue))
		if regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(source) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func reactTreeMatchesSource(source string, rule reactTreeRequirement) bool {
	if rule.Tag != "" {
		pattern := fmt.Sprintf(`(?is)<%s\b`, regexp.QuoteMeta(rule.Tag))
		if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(source) {
			return false
		}
	}
	if len(rule.TextEqualsAny) > 0 {
		matched := false
		for _, item := range rule.TextEqualsAny {
			if strings.Contains(source, item) {
				matched = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !matched {
			return false
		}
	}
	if len(rule.TextContainsAny) > 0 {
		matched := false
		for _, item := range rule.TextContainsAny {
			if strings.Contains(source, item) {
				matched = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !matched {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, item := range rule.TextTemplateContains {
		if !strings.Contains(source, item) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, child := range rule.Children {
		if !reactTreeMatchesSource(source, child) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func asString(raw any) string {
	switch typed := raw.(type) {
	case string:
		return typed
	case json.Number:
		return typed.String()
	case float64:
		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", typed)
	case int:
		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", typed)
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func extractInt(raw any) int {
	switch typed := raw.(type) {
	case float64:
		return int(typed)
	case int:
		return typed
	case int32:
		return int(typed)
	case int64:
		return int(typed)
	case json.Number:
		value, _ := typed.Int64()
		return int(value)
	default:
		return 0
	}
}

func matchesAny(contents []string, pattern string) bool {
	re := regexp.MustCompile(pattern)
	for _, content := range contents {
		if re.MatchString(content) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func normalizePath(path string) string {
	normalized := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(path), "\\", "/")
	normalized = strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, "/")
	for strings.Contains(normalized, "//") {
		normalized = strings.ReplaceAll(normalized, "//", "/")
	}
	return normalized
}

func isHTMLFilePath(path string) bool {
	normalized := strings.ToLower(normalizePath(path))
	return strings.HasSuffix(normalized, ".html") || strings.HasSuffix(normalized, ".htm")
}
